title: Atom Probe Analysis of Nuclear Materials: From Microstructure to Mechanisms
content: A wide variety of materials are used within the nuclear industry. During operations materials can be subject to harsh conditions such as high temperatures, corrosive environments and radiation. To support the safe operation of nuclear plant, it is essential to understand how the materials performance changes over time. This requires an understanding of the degradation mechanisms, which in turn requires knowledge of the underlying microstructure. This talk will focus on two materials used in Light Water Reactors (LWRs); low alloys steels used for the Reactor Pressure Vessel (RPV) and zirconium alloys used as cladding for fuel.
